_about: TODO-30 turn 8 (AB-13), EV-12 under the absolute ambient field, one outer seed per run (montecarlo ambient-evidence). Legacy recipe (montecarlo antimask): lab geometry (scenario.json), centred source, 400 detected source counts, 200 repeats, single mask / calibrated subtraction / two-exposure mask-antimask at equal total time, failure > 3 mm. Here: 400 expected net counts in the window on the mask in the full live time t (10 s, 60 s), activity = 400 / (t x the seed's mask rate); antimask = t/2 mask + t/2 inverted mask at that activity; background = field x t x transported ambient map per bound (inverted-mask map in the front-only bound); calibrated subtraction uses an independent ambient MC map (the instrument's background model) x field x t. Windows: open = every deposit; cs662 = 661.7 keV +-10 %.
